title: Design System: Folio marketing surface (desk instrument)

shadows.name: key-rest
shadows.value: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55), inset 0 -3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 3px 0 var(--key-skirt), 0 8px 14px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.55)
shadows.purpose: Keycap skirt plus soft cast shadow.

shadows.name: key-pressed
shadows.value: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4), inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 1px 0 var(--key-skirt), 0 3px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.5)

motion.name: lcd-redraw
motion.purpose: Screen redraw when a system key or the knob changes.

components.name: Commit Key
components.description: The single commit action per viewport (Deploy).

components.name: Putty Key
components.description: Secondary actions and alternating system keys.

components.name: LCD Readout
components.description: Amber live-state screen; every figure is demo data and labelled so.

narrative.overview: The logged-out site presents Folio as a desk instrument: one appliance (one Docker image) whose keys are its six systems, whose amber screen reads your ledger, and whose rear panel shows every cable landing on hardware you own. It is a separate world from the app's navy/teal system and is scoped under .bench.
keyCharacteristics: Bone and putty keycaps with real travel
Safety orange for the one commit action

rules.name: One Orange Key
rules.body: Only the commit action (Deploy) is orange, and only one per viewport.

rules.name: Demo Is Labelled
rules.body: Every screen figure is synthetic and carries a DEMO label.

rules.name: Keys, Not Buttons
rules.body: Every action is a keycap with travel; lists are ruled rows, never equal card grids.

dos: Do draw the real topology (required vs optional connectors).
Do keep counts computed from the feature registry.
donts: Don't name GnuCash except as an import source.
Don't use overshoot or scroll-entrance motion.
